name: Krippenmuseum Wildermieming
kurzbeschreibung: The Nativity Museum in Wildermieming on the sunny plateau: over 50 artistic Tyrolean and oriental Christmas cribs by master carvers.
beschreibung:
Overview

The atmospheric Krippenmuseum Wildermieming (Nativity Museum Wildermieming) is located on the sun-drenched Mieminger Plateau in the municipality of Wildermieming (Innsbruck-Land district) at an altitude of around 870 meters. Situated in a picturesque setting at the foot of the mighty Mieminger Chain and the Hohe Munde, the museum is a regionally renowned cultural site for living Tyrolean popular piety. With over 50 masterfully designed Christmas cribs, the house documents the centuries-old Tyrolean Nativity carving and Lenten crib tradition, which is recognized by UNESCO as intangible cultural heritage.

Route & Requirements

The exhibition was brought to life by the dedicated work of the Krippenverein Wildermieming (Wildermieming Nativity Association), which preserves historical and contemporary masterpieces by regional carvers and Nativity scene builders. A tour through the atmospherically darkened exhibition rooms allows visitors to experience the full diversity of Alpine and Oriental Nativity art: admire detailed Tyrolean home cribs, which transpose the biblical Christmas story into snowy Alpine landscapes in front of historic Tyrolean farmhouses and alpine huts, as well as monumental Oriental splendor cribs with detailed caravanserais, bazaars, and oases. The hand-carved wooden figures by renowned Tyrolean carving families are dressed in hand-woven, noble brocade and silk fabrics. A special cultural-historical highlight are the rare Lenten and Passion cribs, which depict the suffering and resurrection of Christ in poignant scenes.

Visit & Arrival

The Krippenmuseum Wildermieming is open during the pre-Christmas and winter season from the end of November to the end of January on Saturdays and Sundays from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM; during the summer months, guided tours for groups of 8 or more people are possible at any time by prior arrangement. Admission prices (as of season 2025/2026): Adults approx. €5.00, seniors approx. €4.00, children and teenagers (6 to 15 years) approx. €2.50, toddlers free; family ticket approx. €12.00. Visitors receive discounted admission with the regional Welcome Card of the Innsbruck region. Arrival by car: Via the Inntalautobahn A12 (Telfs West exit), then continue on the Mieminger Straße B189 onto the sunny plateau and to Wildermieming; free parking is available at the municipal office/community center. By public transport: ÖBB to Telfs-Pfaffenhofen train station, from there take Postbus line 4176 directly to the Wildermieming Gemeindeamt stop.

Tips

The museum in the community center is barrier-free and accessible for wheelchairs and strollers via a ramp and threshold-free doors. After visiting the museum, a walk along the Bergdoktorhaus-Weg to the historic inn, which served as a backdrop for the popular TV series, is worthwhile. Warm up in the nearby village café with hot mulled apple cider and homemade Tyrolean fruit bread.
